required_observations.baseline: owner identity reads owner-owned resource with bounded semantic identity
required_observations.candidate: distinct requester identity requests same owner resource
required_observations.negative_control: independent denied or nonexistent resource with distinct request digest

oracle_contract.expected_invariant: requester session cannot read the owner-owned profile/object
oracle_contract.violated_invariant: requester session receives the owner-owned profile/object semantic identity
oracle_contract.promotion_rule: only CONFIRMED may create a scoring ProofBundle

source_backed_findings.finding: GET profile endpoint is bound to LessonSession identity and does not expose an independently addressable owner resource.
Alternate assignment is POST and validates the session-bound authenticated user ID; it is not the required GET-only owner/requester fixture.

required_next_capability: Owner-approved local LessonSession owner/requester fixture injection and reset with bounded GET semantic observation; any login, credentials, token generation, mutation, or new permission requires a separate owner decision packet.
